scope: Primary source and installed SDK accounting research only

sources.finding: macOS AVAILABLE_NON_COMPRESSED_MEMORY includes active, inactive, free and speculative counters; memorystatus level is not an allocatable free-byte budget.
Available accounting includes reclaimable memory; reclaiming anonymous pages may require compression or swapping. This does not prove no-pressure admission.
Per-process memory-limit remainder, not physical host headroom; installed SDK declares this API unavailable on macOS.
The exact pinned runtime documents process.availableMemory() as stable and returning available bytes, delegating accounting to libuv; it is not the macOS percentage.

Pinned Node 24.21 Darwin uv_get_available_memory uses free_count + inactive_count + purgeable_count times page size; uv_get_free_memory uses free_count only. The available result includes reclaimable counters and is not a guarantee of allocation without compression or swap.

requiredBeforeAdmission: Specify conservative available-byte measurement without active/anonymous or speculative double counting
Measure normal pressure and stable swap under current load
Verify available >=1.5 GB and sealed aggregate ceiling +512 MiB margin
Physical-RAM fit and exclusive shared heavy-work lease
Real aggregate descendant capacity and pressure-loss teardown evidence
conclusion: Existing percentages are read-only host observations. No stack or supported inference has been admitted; resource owner implementation remains absent.

pinnedRuntimeAccounting.requiredDecision: Choose and verify a conservative byte policy with normal pressure, stable swap and the sealed aggregate ceiling plus margin; no percentage multiplication.

pressureMappingResearch.finding: The read-only masked kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level sysctl maps internal kVMPressureNormal to NOTE_MEMORYSTATUS_PRESSURE_NORMAL, Warning/Urgent to WARN and Critical to CRITICAL before returning userspace data. It does not return the internal zero-based enum.
limitations: Current upstream primary source is not a source-to-running-kernel build attestation.
The masked sysctl is not a documented stable public pressure-query API; failure or unknown values must remain unknown and block admission.
No live pressure value, swap-stability interval, conservative byte policy, heavy lease or runtime permit was established by this research.
